people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
translations.bsb: Like fluttering birds pushed out of the nest, so are the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon:
translations.kjv: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
translations.asv: For it shall be that, as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so shall the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
